title: Filipino-Style Cornmeal Crusted Tofu with Earthy Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious dish that combines the earthy taste of pilaf with the crispy cornmeal crust of tofu.
instructions: Mix cornmeal, garlic, and ginger in a bowl.
Crumble tofu into the bowl and toss to coat with cornmeal mixture.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer tofu to a baking sheet and bake for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until crispy.
While tofu is baking, heat pilaf in a saucepan over medium heat. Add soy sauce and stir to combine.
Toss cooked tofu with pilaf mixture and top with scallions.
